decisions.reason: The bottle-and-smoke clipping decision concerns the standalone strawberry asset; smoke in this candidate is the rendering of a separate slogan and remains unchanged.
Although this separate illustration includes a bottle, the source and local context refer specifically to the bottle and smoke in the standalone strawberry composition.
The candidate is a separate stamped-meat illustration and has no bottle, smoke, or clipping state affected by the source decision.
The source decision about retaining and fully displaying a bottle and smoke in another asset does not alter this candidate's sky-text requirements.
The composition and clipping clarification does not change the project-wide hand-drawn, non-AI production method.
The source decision changes visible elements within the standalone asset but does not alter the required green-background and non-green-background PNG variants.
